features.title: Capability-based platform compatibility API
features.notes: Centralizes Minecraft parsing, platform detection, feature probes, declarative addon requirements, and additive compatibility helpers.

features.title: Multi-fork upstream candidate radar
features.notes: Reports new source revisions without automatically merging or replacing Legacy files.

features.title: Documented addon API deprecation lifecycle
features.notes: Adds a documented deprecation annotation, replacement guidance, no default removal schedule, and retained binary bridges.

features.title: Capability-routed scheduler and event boundary
features.notes: Routes scheduler and event ownership decisions through the centralized detector and platform service while retaining legacy entry points.

features.title: Compatibility-protected API signature baseline
features.notes: Guards all 991 public and protected 4.1.19 source signatures in compatibility-protected packages while allowing additive APIs.

features.title: Runtime addon compatibility declarations and diagnostics
features.notes: Adds explicit registration, provider, and embedded-manifest declarations without requiring changes to legacy addons.

features.title: Representative addon source and binary compatibility matrix
features.notes: Compares addon source builds against baseline and candidate cores, then validates the baseline-compiled addon against candidate JVM symbols.

features.title: Central optional-dependency and guarded-reflection boundary
features.notes: Provides additive plugin, class, method, and guarded invocation helpers for optional addon integrations.

features.title: Optional core module dependency graph
features.notes: Allow controlled feature toggles without changing item IDs or silently disabling data-bearing systems.

features.title: Unified localization key registry with English fallback
features.notes: Preserve the English-first experience while giving addons stable message and item keys.

features.title: Storage consistency and migration audit tools
features.notes: Extend existing schema-v3 and Doctor work with dry-run integrity checks and explicit rollback plans.

features.title: Optional staff multitool modes
features.notes: Evaluate only after core compatibility phases; preserve existing staff IDs and behavior by default.

features.title: Rolling previous-stable compatibility baseline
features.notes: Moves the release-blocking addon and API baseline to one machine-readable registry. Phase 1D compares 4.1.22 against 4.1.21 instead of leaving 4.1.15 hard-coded in workflow YAML.

features.title: Advisory historical compatibility floor
features.notes: Retains 4.1.15 as a non-blocking long-term drift probe while separating it from the active previous-stable regression gate.

features.title: External machine, storage, cargo, and energy capability adapters
features.notes: Planned adapter boundary for Pylon, Rebar, and similar machine/storage ecosystems. Keep integrations optional and capability-driven rather than hard-coding plugin internals.

features.title: Unified runtime failure quarantine and diagnostics registry
features.notes: Extend existing machine circuit breakers and guide/addon isolation into a shared failure registry with rate-limited diagnostics and Doctor visibility.
